data.name: Bond Senses
data.description: As a standard action, share the senses of your eidolon, hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting, and touching everything your eidolon does. You can use this ability %1 rounds per day. There is no range to this effect, but your eidolon and you must be on the same plane. You can end this effect as a free action.|BondSensesRounds
